result:
Phase 1 is complete and checkpointed as `pending_review`. Summary:

- **superboss-register.py** (live server script): added a nullable `tags` TEXT column to `system_index` via an idempotent, self-healing `ALTER TABLE` migration, plus `--tags` on `index-add` and `--tag` filter on `search`. Diff committed at `ai-os/patches/superboss-register-tags-column-2026-07-23.diff`.
- **Real finding along the way**: `system_index` had 0 rows, not the 12 MASTER_INDEX.yaml claimed — the prior phase's DB corruption/reinit had silently emptied it. Restored those 11 (12th, `software-request-analyzer.py`, doesn't exist on disk — not fabricated) plus tagged the 18 previously-untagged scripts, all 29 with real `module:<name>` tags inferred from each script's own header docstring and cross-checked against live crontab/systemd evidence.
- **MASTER_INDEX.yaml** updated to match; flagged (not fixed) two further real inventory-accuracy gaps for a future pass.
- **ai-os/EXECUTION_RULES_AUDIT_2026-07-23.yaml**: Parts 14/15/20 given real before/after evidence; Parts 16-19/21/22 each got a one-line note on why they're unaffected.
- Verified via `postflight_audit_gate.py` (AUD-20260723-063804-0d89cc, DONE), committed+pushed (8f3b587, 0a934c2), owner notified by real email, and phase 2 (`pre_execution_checklist_automation`, Parts 38b/39/40) self-dispatched as its own task — the final allowed self-dispatch per the 3-phase cap.

Also worth flagging: this sandbox's bash wrapper silently truncates large redirected command output with a fabricated "... more files changed" marker — the same defect the audit file already documents from a prior session. I worked around it using the Read/Write tools and in-process Python instead of bash redirects for anything load-bearing, and noted it in PROGRESS.md.
